name: Asterion Veyra
subtitle: Personal assistant, voice and desktop pairing
localizedDescription: Personal AI assistant with voice, notes and explicitly paired desktop access. Choose a supported response source and pair only the desktop you intend to use. Requires iOS 26 or later and a supported signing/container setup. Published build and automated checks are verified; installation and behavior on your physical device remain untested by this catalog.

name: OmniForge
subtitle: Offline AI developer workbench
localizedDescription: Import local GGUF models, inspect IPA files and work with development projects. Models are supplied separately. Unsigned iOS guest app for a configured LiveContainer or a supported signing method. Minimum iOS 17. Release packaging has been inspected; this catalog does not certify physical-device operation.

name: VoiceMatrix
subtitle: Offline character speech and voice tools
localizedDescription: Import your own character folders, create offline speech and convert recordings with local neural engines. No stock characters are bundled. Experimental character-test edition: native diagnostic speech and simulator conversion checks pass, but physical iPhone behavior and character likeness remain unverified. Requires iOS 26.

name: Afterlight
subtitle: Original survival-game prototype
localizedDescription: Original procedural survival-game prototype, separate from Call of Duty. Contains no BO2 assets or third-party game engine in this published version. Simulation and simulator smoke checks are reported as passed; physical-device play remains unverified. Unsigned IPA requires LiveContainer or signing. iOS 17+. Owner avatar is shown because this prototype has no bundled app icon.

name: Zombies iOS File Tools
subtitle: Game-file scanner and runtime research
localizedDescription: Experimental BO2/PS3 file scanner and importer with native runtime development in progress. Supply your own legally obtained files. This is not verified complete Zombies gameplay. Unsigned automated build; physical-device behavior remains unverified. iOS 17+. Owner avatar is shown because the build has no bundled app icon.

name: CS2 iOS Runtime Lab
subtitle: Native graphics and input test shell
localizedDescription: Clean-room native iOS runtime research shell for Metal graphics, audio, controllers, touch and lifecycle logging. This device-test build is not Counter-Strike 2 gameplay and contains no Valve game assets. Requires signing or a compatible container, iOS 17+. Physical-device behavior remains unverified. Owner avatar is shown because no app icon is bundled.

name: BOZ Compatibility Test
subtitle: Experimental integrated-input build
localizedDescription: Experimental unsigned compatibility update for an existing COD: Black Ops Zombies installation in Strata. Includes integrated manual touch controls; physical-device input feel and session stability remain unverified. This release retains third-party game engine/content and is not an original engine reconstruction; redistribution rights are not certified by this catalog. Read the release INSTALL.md before updating and preserve the existing data container. The listed iOS requirement includes embedded-library minimums, not only the app plist.
releaseNotes: Integrated-input compatibility test build. Native ARM64 input checks are reported by the release. Existing engine and content are retained. Follow the published installation guide for the existing Strata setup; no new maps or weapons. Device behavior remains unverified.

name: Native Zombies Prototype
subtitle: Original Metal survival-game prototype
localizedDescription: Experimental original native survival-game prototype with procedural visuals, waves, weapons, touch/controller input and developer controls. Separate from Afterlight and not an Activision game. The reviewed source build passed 20 simulator unit tests and an ARM64 device build; physical-device gameplay and SideStore installation remain untested. Unsigned IPA requires compatible signing. iOS 17+. Owner avatar is used because no reviewed app screenshot or bundled icon is available.
